criteria.sector: exact expected broad engine sector from published catalog mapping; unknown is a separately counted abstention, not a correct explicit identity
criteria.subtype: exact catalog key, informational due broad legacy aliases; never substituted after measurement
criteria.applicability: non-retail cases must not receive ecommerce/product/checkout/merchant modules or retail warnings/fails; retail case must receive ecommerce/product/checkout modules
criteria.falsePositives: each forbidden module or warning/fail on non-retail checks counts one FP; incorrect non-unknown sector counts one sector FP
criteria.falseNegatives: missing required retail module counts one FN; unknown/wrong explicit sector counts one sector FN
criteria.seoGeoEvidence: exact title, description, canonical and JSON-LD count; warning/fail evidence must include URL, source and concrete found/details; this is limited evidence integrity, not a full semantic audit
criteria.coverage: PAGE_SAMPLE only; selected count reconciles outcomes; reported audited count equals actual audited page entries; no full-site claim
criteria.consistency: classification sector agrees; page type agrees; check status agrees with issue_status and score breakdown; summary counts reconcile; N/A/unknown earn no points

acceptance: No 9/10 certification from synthetic data. Each dimension >=90%, no new baseline regressions, plus external independent evidence, security/browser/data review still required.
